name: Wayback Machine CDX Server
bulk_access: Pagination API (page=, showNumPages=, resumeKey=) for large queries; no dump documented

name: Wayback Save Page Now 2 API
rate_limit: Daily bandwidth: 5GB per authenticated user, 2GB per anonymous user, 100GB per host (docs); per-URL daily capture cap is not stated as a limit (the number 10 appears only inside an example error message)

name: Internet Archive Advanced Search
rate_limit: Docs give no numbers: automated tools should add delays, honor 429 responses and Retry-After headers, and send a descriptive User-Agent.

name: Internet Archive Metadata API
rate_limit: Docs give no numbers: automated tools should add delays, honor 429 responses and Retry-After headers, and send a descriptive User-Agent.

name: Internet Archive Scholar / fatcat
bulk_access: https://archive.org/details/fatcat_snapshots_and_exports (database dumps, changelog, identifier snapshots, entity exports)

name: Common Crawl Index
bulk_access: https://data.commoncrawl.org/ (HTTPS), s3://commoncrawl/ (authenticated S3 API only); Columnar Index recommended for bulk

name: Arquivo.pt Web Archive
rate_limit: Rate limit listed as 250 a 400 on dados.gov.pt (unit and window not stated there)
bulk_access: CDXJ index files publicly available for bulk download (announced at https://sobre.arquivo.pt/en/tag/api/)

name: Software Heritage Archive
rate_limit: 120 requests per hour for anonymous users, 1200 per hour for authenticated users (per origin IP for anonymous).
bulk_access: https://docs.softwareheritage.org/devel/swh-export/graph/dataset.html (graph dataset exports, ORC and compressed graph, public S3, no login)

name: Library of Congress API
rate_limit: loc.gov JSON/YAML API: 20 requests per minute, blocked 1 hour if exceeded; Text and Image services 150 per minute; Streaming 60 per minute; MARCXML on lccn.loc.gov 30 per minute, blocked 72 hours.
bulk_access: MARC Open Access dataset (catalog records up through 2014); the docs name it but give no URL in the captured text

name: Europeana Search API
bulk_access: https://pro.europeana.eu dataset download via ftp://download.europeana.eu/dataset/XML/ and OAI-PMH at https://api.europeana.eu/oai/record/

name: HathiTrust Bibliographic API
bulk_access: OAI-PMH or HathiFiles (named only by a third-party reference page, not by HathiTrust docs in this sandbox)

name: Open Library API
rate_limit: Default (non-identified) 1 request per second; identified requests with User-Agent and email 3 requests per second.
data_license: No new copyright asserted by the Internet Archive over Open Library database material; no named open license (e.g. CC0) stated on the captured pages.

name: Gutendex (Project Gutenberg)
bulk_access: none documented (docs say Project Gutenberg itself publishes nightly catalog archives, and to self-host Gutendex for long-term use)

name: US National Archives Catalog API
rate_limit: 10,000 queries per month per API key by default; key blocked until the first of the next month when exceeded; higher limit on request.
data_license: Public domain (US federal government work), with rare exceptions
bulk_access: API can facilitate bulk downloads of records (no separate dump URL documented in captured text)

name: Smithsonian Open Access API
rate_limit: api.data.gov defaults: 1,000 requests per hour per key; DEMO_KEY 30 per IP per hour and 50 per IP per day. Probe response header showed X-Ratelimit-Limit: 10.
data_license: CC0 (per-record access field in probe; GitHub README does not state licence)

name: MediaWiki Action API (Wikipedia)
rate_limit: No hard speed limit on read requests; make requests in series; edit/state-changing requests are rate limited per action and user rights. Dumps: 3 connections per IP.
data_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text contributions under Wikimedia Terms of Use)
bulk_access: https://dumps.wikimedia.org/ (monthly dumps; MediaWiki Content File Exports)

name: Wikidata API / SPARQL
rate_limit: Docs give no numbers: on HTTP 429 stop and honour Retry-After; send a good User-Agent; global Wikimedia API rate limits apply.

name: OpenAlex
rate_limit: Anonymous: shared $0.10 per day per IP; free key: $1 per day, resets midnight UTC; probe header X-RateLimit-Limit 1000 with 993 remaining.
bulk_access: s3://openalex (full snapshot, JSONL and Parquet; browse at openalex.s3.amazonaws.com/browse.html)

name: Crossref REST API
rate_limit: Per-IP limiting; probe headers showed x-rate-limit-limit 1 with x-rate-limit-interval 1s on the public pool; back off on HTTP 429. Docs give no other numbers.
data_license: No named license: docs say almost none of the metadata is subject to copyright and it may be used for any purpose (some abstracts may be copyrighted)
bulk_access: Annual public data file (all data); monthly snapshot and OAI-PMH for paid Metadata Plus subscribers

name: DataCite REST API
rate_limit: Unidentified: 500 requests per 5 minutes per IP address; identified (User-Agent email or mailto=): 1000 per 5 minutes; authenticated: 3000 per 5 minutes; 429 when limited.
data_license: CC0 (documented for metadata in the DataCite Public Data File)
bulk_access: https://datafiles.datacite.org/ (DataCite Public Data File, annual); docs also list a Monthly Data File and an OAI-PMH guide

name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph
rate_limit: Unauthenticated: 1000 requests per second shared among all unauthenticated users, may be throttled further; introductory API key rate 1 RPS on all endpoints.
data_license: Varies per dataset: S2 Data Licenses such as CC BY-NC or ODC-BY
bulk_access: Datasets API https://api.semanticscholar.org/datasets/v1/release/ (S2AG downloadable JSON archive; download links need an API key)

name: CORE API
rate_limit: One batch request or five single requests per 10 seconds; registered users get a faster rate, VIP rate on request.
data_license: ODC-By for CORE datasets; other datasets and the API need a CORE licence under the Terms & Conditions (free licence for eligible individuals and public research organisations)
bulk_access: CORE Dataset (https://core.ac.uk/services/dataset); ODC-By licenced datasets per https://core.ac.uk/terms; FastSync also listed

name: arXiv API
rate_limit: Legacy APIs (OAI-PMH, RSS, arXiv API): no more than one request every three seconds, single connection at a time; limits apply to all machines under your control and may change.
data_license: Descriptive metadata is CC0 1.0 (Public Domain Dedication); full text follows each e-print's own license.
bulk_access: OAI-PMH (preferred for bulk metadata); full text via Amazon S3 and Kaggle; see https://info.arxiv.org/help/bulk_data.html

name: NCBI E-utilities (PubMed)
rate_limit: 3 requests/second per IP without an API key; 10 requests/second per key with one (NCBI Insights post).
bulk_access: PubMed FTP baseline and daily update files, see https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/download/

name: PMC ID Converter API
bulk_access: PMC-ids.csv.gz at https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/pmc/PMC-ids.csv.gz (docs also list an OAI-PMH Service page, not captured)

name: Directory of Open Access Journals API
rate_limit: two requests per second on all API routes, bursts of up to five queued requests per user
bulk_access: OAI-PMH feed and a public data dump (access granted case-by-case by emailing the platform manager); journal CSV also listed

name: OpenAIRE Graph API
rate_limit: Unauthenticated up to 60 requests per hour; authenticated up to 7200 requests per hour.
bulk_access: Full graph dataset on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3516917 (offset paging also capped at 10,000 results; cursor paging available)

name: BASE (Bielefeld Academic Search Engine)
bulk_access: OAI-PMH at http://oai.base-search.net/oai (IP-restricted, non-commercial projects apply); full dump on request via contact for an initial load

name: bioRxiv / medRxiv API
data_license: Per-article, chosen by authors (CC-BY, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-NC-ND, CC-BY-ND, CC0 and no-CC); stated in the license field of each record's metadata
bulk_access: Full text via Amazon S3 requester-pays bucket s3://biorxiv-src-monthly (monthly deposits; AWS charges borne by user); metadata via API pagination with OAI-PMH style XML format

name: ORCID Public API
bulk_access: ORCID Public Data File (annual release), documented at https://info.orcid.org/public-data-file-use-policy/

name: Research Organization Registry API
rate_limit: 2000 requests in a 5-minute period per IP address

name: INSPIRE HEP API
rate_limit: 15 requests in a 5s window per IP address; exceeding returns HTTP 429
data_license: Most metadata CC0; restrictions apply to some fields; bulk collection of email addresses not allowed

name: NASA Astrophysics Data System API
rate_limit: Each endpoint individually rate-limited; example header shows X-RateLimit-Limit: 5000 daily queries per user, reset at midnight UTC

name: dblp API
data_license: CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication for metadata (secondary license ODC-BY 1.0)

name: OpenCitations Index API
bulk_access: https://download.opencitations.net/ (dumps on Zenodo, Figshare and Internet Archive)

name: zbMATH Open API
bulk_access: OAI-PMH API at https://oai.zbmath.org/ (captured page shows only its Terms & Conditions gate)

name: SciELO ArticleMeta API
data_license: CC-BY for journal content (standard since 2015; journals indexed earlier may keep original license); license of API metadata itself not stated

name: Zenodo REST API
data_license: CC0 for metadata (Creative Commons Zero); files carry per-record licenses
bulk_access: OAI-PMH at https://zenodo.org/oai2d (docs also mention metadata dumps)

name: Figshare API
rate_limit: No automatic rate limiting; docs recommend no more than one request per second and reserve the right to throttle or block.

name: Open Science Framework API
rate_limit: Per api/base/settings/defaults.py (source code, not prose docs): non-cookie-auth 100/hour, user 10000/day, burst 10/second, files 75/minute.
data_license: Per-record: public content is under the license identified by the project Administrator.

name: Dryad API
data_license: Datasets are published under CC0 (per Terms of Service).

name: GBIF API
rate_limit: No fixed numbers; search APIs may return HTTP 429 depending on server load, and the maximum rate is not guaranteed. Scripts running over 15 minutes should use the download API.
data_license: Per dataset: CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0 (list of supported GBIF licenses)
bulk_access: Occurrence download API (asynchronous, registered users); monthly occurrence exports on AWS, Google GCS and Azure (https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/)

name: PubChem PUG REST
rate_limit: Asked to make no more than 5 requests per second; no API keys or whitelists to exceed this; automated throttling applies.
data_license: No single license: NCBI places no restrictions itself, but PubChem data sources may claim rights and license per source.
bulk_access: https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubchem/ (PubChem FTP site for bulk download)

name: Springer Nature API
rate_limit: Basic plan: 500 hits/day and 100 hits/min throttling for the Open Access API; Premium plan: 10,000 hits/day and 300 hits/min.
bulk_access: Premium plan lists bulk data access (no dump or OAI-PMH route documented in captured pages)

name: Elsevier Developer Portal (Scopus/ScienceDirect)
rate_limit: Per-API weekly quotas and per-second throttling, e.g. Scopus Search 20,000 requests per week at 9 requests/second; ScienceDirect Article Retrieval 50,000 per week at 10/second; quotas reset every seven days.

name: The Lens API
bulk_access: Bulk Data Downloads of scholarly and patent files via the API or UI (https://docs.api.lens.org/bulk-data.html); access is requested from the Lens account

name: Dimensions Analytics API
rate_limit: 30 requests per IP address per minute (Analytics API and CRIS API); query token valid for around 2 hours

name: scite API
rate_limit: Without an Authentication Token: up to 10 requests per second, up to 40 requests per minute; tallies and papers endpoints are uncapped (docs). Probe response headers showed X-RateLimit-Limit-Minute 60.

name: Trove API (NLA)
rate_limit: Per-key call rate is requested on the application form and set on approval; the review-levels table lists a call rate of 200m (unit not stated).
bulk_access: Docs navigation links a 'Bulk download' page (https://trove.nla.gov.au/about/create-something/bulk-download); page itself not captured
